notes.title: Unidentified Flying Pyramid
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://64.media.tumblr.com/1817fface80fdf99690403e6f16c87d0/bea843accff59fc7-b3/s1280x1920/01270e4115c1bda73e707626ca96fc78a18ff946.pnj"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://64.media.tumblr.com/1b1c0b3cb99d18e851e59f7743e3d540/bea843accff59fc7-0a/s1280x1920/2cb16e83f3c47181fbf4e72b490b03cd709a32c6.pnj"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]For the morbidly curious, the Codex is your best friend. It logs every strange creature you defeat, from item drops to their bizarre backstories. You can finally learn the official, canonical truth about the elusive U.F.P…. which is that "it is unknown what type of object this flying pyramid is."[/p]

notes.title: Alphuck
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="51COJ4qZbs4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The game's first midboss, Alphuck, has a fuse shorter than the Planck length. He seems to have a questionable attraction to employment and ressentiment towards those who lack it. His contrarian attitude makes him unpopular. For unknown reasons, extreme anger causes him to explode.[/p]

[p][/p][previewyoutube="FjyZMN939ok;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The Abusement Park is a late-game dungeon, its decaying grounds containing the abandoned Queen's Isle, long surrendered to disrepair and floodwater. 

You see, the Abusement Park got its name becau- wait a second. There's no enemies here... where did they all go?[/p]

notes.title: Dr. Plover
notes.notes:
[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/42d835a140f0697a385ff9872683706b/e0ff8f2c0b29bbba-49/s1280x1920/9a220616361ffe6b7b98752431a83bdbf08f05b5.pnj[/img]

Dr. Plover is a species of bird where each generation graduates from dental school. Unlike most students, Dr. Plover managed to escape student debt. Nowadays, the bird is commonly found overseeing the dental health of Nile Diles.

notes.title: Frank's "Basic Attack"
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=O4-68HWRWRQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Frank's standard attack has you launch an 8-ball with manual precision, then watch the chaos unfold as it bounces between enemies (ouch!) and allies (thanks for the heal!). Part weapon, part healing device, all physics demonstration.

notes.title: Subprime Morty
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205445/f27c1feed3d7a3153eeb3c1dedf72328bf40a2cf.png[/img]

Following the housing crisis of years past, Old Sport Bank foreclosed on numerous homes. These houses have vowed to never be hurt again and thus will protect themselves with elemental bubbles. They long to see their inhabitants once more. 

Plus: these babies are sturdier than dinosaurs!

notes.title: Mystery Skulls
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=2Qe99ohhd2Q;full][/previewyoutube]

These mysterious green skulls are scattered all across the world, desperate to share trivia that's fascinating, accurate, and completely useless to you. I think. There's something oddly compelling about collecting them all...

notes.title: Carpooling With Your Friends
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=QnA_UD59460;full][/previewyoutube]
To travel between world maps, you'll have to survive wormhole transit. Think of it as carpooling with your party, but with more bullets, enemy aircraft, and undocumented biological anomalies trying to turn your ship into abstract modern art.

notes.title: Unwavering Realism
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=cz4Fll9WxTY;full][/previewyoutube]
Thanks to Eulogy of an Insect's unwavering penchant for realism, destroying anything an enemy is perched on top of will cause them to react accordingly. 

Luckily, you're right in on the ground floor for the rare chance to separate a beetle from his hard-earned dung.

notes.title: Vigilance
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ZLfZDGj3YCQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Did you know? "Vigilance", the powerful song featured in Eulogy of an Insect's official trailer, is actually the game's main battle theme! Chuck Salamone did an incredible job on this track. It was the second composition ever created for the game.

notes.title: It Won't Save You
notes.notes:
In the blood-drenched halls of Milady Sanitarium, your newfound firearm will help you solve puzzles from a distance and handle any sanguineous monstrosities you'll encounter. But it won't save you from infection...

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/e9dfac98c586620ff9b52dc22996bf44/65db9ccac832774b-ff/s1280x1920/699ab2a39134b8a81bb28d0dfd8eee3bbb354575.pnj[/img]

notes.title: Is This You?
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=RIYC6V3IMOU;full][/previewyoutube]

You have the power to shape not only your destiny, but those of others. For example, you can tell your friends that Eulogy of an Insect is available to wishlist on Steam.

notes.title: Every Step Squelches Sickeningly
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=AVQwwNM_HPk;full][/previewyoutube]

Every step squelches sickeningly in this makeshift city - the frozen corpse of a mysterious ice giant that the local maggot mob now calls home. The remaining white blood cells are learning that resistance... is terminal.

notes.title: Target Practice
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=bdI1EURKUqw;full][/previewyoutube]

Death outside of battle is a rare but special possibility in Eulogy of an Insect. For instance, the shooting range lets you target anything you aim at - no exceptions. Talk about a splitting headache... anyone got some ibuprofen?

notes.title: Random Encounters, Begone
notes.notes:
No random encounters here - meet on the field in a race to strike first. Ambush your enemies to grant your party Boost status, enhancing all abilities. Get caught by surprise, and you'll find yourself on the wrong end of that power spike.
[previewyoutube=DF5oi28BOXc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Capitalism Ahoy!
notes.notes:
That crusty old pagoda was *such* an eyesore before it was renovated into the hot new Pagoda Mall, the second dungeon in Eulogy of an Insect. You'll contend with long lines, mall security, and soccer moms as you revive languishing businesses and tear down the hot new one.

notes.title: Wretched Retching
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Tsm8TvojOTw;full][/previewyoutube]

Most RPG characters swing swords or use magic, but Lilah has mastered the art of projectile vomiting as her "basic attack". Perfect your timing using the stomach acid gauge to inflict chain vomiting and Wretched status. 

Hold too long, and... well, she really should've brought a bib.
